reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000423 (the melody read from 000423a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells George Coles Stebbins as “George Coles Stubbins”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. George Coles Stebbins's dates (1846–1945) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Stebbins_GC (Stebbins, George C. (George Coles), 1846-1945; CCEH spells him Stubbins); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Coles_Stebbins agrees; CCEH's page gives only the year 1878. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000423a.nwc).
